events.title: Birth of Johann Sebastian Bach
events.description: Composer and organist Johann Sebastian Bach was born in Eisenach, Thuringia, in the Holy Roman Empire (by the Gregorian calendar; March 11 in the Julian calendar then used locally). He became one of the most celebrated composers in Western music history, known for works such as the Brandenburg Concertos, the Mass in B minor, and The Well-Tempered Clavier.
events.significance: Bach's mastery of counterpoint, harmony, and form shaped the foundations of Western classical music and influenced generations of composers.

events.title: Sharpeville Massacre
events.description: South African police opened fire on a crowd of Black protesters demonstrating against apartheid pass laws in the township of Sharpeville, killing 69 people and wounding many more.
events.significance: The massacre drew worldwide condemnation of apartheid, led to a state of emergency and the banning of the ANC and PAC, and prompted the UN to establish March 21 as the International Day for the Elimination of Racial Discrimination.

events.title: Alcatraz Federal Penitentiary Closes
events.description: The notorious federal prison on Alcatraz Island in San Francisco Bay was closed by order of Attorney General Robert F. Kennedy after nearly 30 years of operation, largely due to high operating costs and deteriorating facilities.
events.significance: Alcatraz became a symbol of American incarceration and later a popular national park and tourist site; its closure marked the end of an era in the U.S. federal prison system.

events.title: Namibia Becomes Independent
events.description: Namibia gained independence from South Africa, which had administered the territory since World War I. Sam Nujoma was sworn in as the country's first president, and the Namibian flag was raised in Windhoek.
events.significance: Namibia's independence ended decades of colonial and South African rule and was one of the last major decolonization events in Africa, marking a key step in the broader dismantling of white minority rule in the region.

events.title: Twitter Is Founded
events.description: Jack Dorsey sent the first message on Twitter, 'just setting up my twttr', launching the microblogging platform that he co-founded with Biz Stone, Evan Williams, and Noah Glass.
events.significance: Twitter became a major global platform for news, politics, and public discourse, transforming how information spreads and how public figures communicate.
